changes.title: 58 million under heat alerts as extreme temperatures scorch western U.S.
changes.summary: Heat alerts were issued for millions across parts of the western U.S. Sunday as an unusually prolonged heat dome reached its peak.

changes.title: Lindsey Graham, Republican Senator and Trump Ally, Dies From ‘Sudden Illness’
changes.summary: He consistently pushed for the use of U.S. military power overseas. The Washington, D.C., medical examiner said he died of an aortic dissection, a tear in the body’s main artery.

changes.title: Oil Prices Surge After Iran and U.S. Trade Strikes
changes.summary: The renewed hostilities posed fresh risks to ships seeking to navigate the Strait of Hormuz.

changes.title: Eat your ice cream for a long, healthy life? This doctor says so
changes.summary: Dr. Zeke Emanuel, a renowned U.S. health policy physician, takes on the wellness industry with a back-to-basics approach to optimizing good health. (Image credit: WeBond Creations).

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: The U.S. strikes Iran for a third weekend as Iran retaliates by hitting Gulf nations, Sen. Lindsey Graham died Saturday at the age of 71, Congress returns from recess this week.

changes.title: With Lindsey Graham Gone, Ukraine Loses an Ally in Trump’s Ear
changes.summary: The South Carolina Republican was Ukraine’s most influential champion inside President Trump’s mostly “America First” political orbit.

changes.title: Tributes pour in for Lindsey Graham after his death stuns D.C.
changes.summary: Tributes poured in for Sen. Lindsey Graham from Democrats, Republicans, former U.S. presidents and world leaders after his death stunned Capitol Hill. CBS News' Caitlin Huey-Burns has more.
